description: The system in another format. 'scene' is JSON (paths, sizes and positions in metres); 'stl' is ASCII STL of every part; 'qif' is a QIF 3.0 (ISO 23952) document with the product structure, datums and every characteristic (tolerances, toleranced sizes, measurements); 'ap242' is STEP AP242 (ISO 10303-242) with the product structure, tessellated bodies and semantic PMI. 'usd' is an OpenUSD stage (USDA, Z up, metres) for NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim: parts nested by containment, meshes, materials, UsdPhysics rigid bodies, colliders and joints, sensor cameras, semantic labels, pinned to the model SHA-256. QIF and AP242 carry the same persistent id per characteristic. Output for qif and ap242: { file_name, characteristics, notes, content, pinned_text? }; for usd: { file_name, model_sha256, content }.

root.description: The top level part usage to elaborate (default: the last one, the configured system).

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.
